mapper.select: SELECT path,title,group_key AS "group",group_title,'' AS permission,sort_order,visible,revision FROM c2k_menu_setting WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} ORDER BY sort_order,path
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO c2k_menu_setting(tenant_id,path,title,group_key,group_title,sort_order,visible,revision) VALUES(#{tenant},#{row.path},#{row.title},#{row.group},#{row.groupTitle},#{row.sortOrder},#{row.visible},#{row.revision}) ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,path) DO UPDATE SET title=EXCLUDED.title,group_key=EXCLUDED.group_key,group_title=EXCLUDED.group_title, sort_order=EXCLUDED.sort_order,visible=EXCLUDED.visible,revision=EXCLUDED.revision
